documents.note: Document metadata (title, filename, type, dates, and the AI-generated summary if one was generated) is included. The original uploaded files are NOT included in this export — download them individually from Settings → Documents, or via the document API.

workouts.note: Workout summary records (duration, distance, heart rate, calories, steps) are included. GPS routes and per-sample heart-rate/pace time series are not included in this export.

mentalHealth.note: Completed WHO-5, PHQ and GAD administrations are not included in this export. Their per-item answers are stored encrypted and include the PHQ-9 self-harm item, which is not written into a portable file. They are included in a disaster-recovery backup, which returns to the instance that can read them.

consent.note: Consent receipts are not included in this export. A consent is given to one operator, and a receipt restored elsewhere would assert an agreement that operator never obtained. They are included in a disaster-recovery backup, which returns to the same instance.
